cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. We're so glad you're staying. The guest bed is yours; just no food upstairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll have my breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Lovely. After nine, please; we keep the kitchen quiet before then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Could I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love you to have one. Breakfast food stays in the kitchen, though. Can you catch a later train?

mechanism: Misread a guest's muddy shoes as an absolute household practice, then warmly enforce it with tightening slipper and washing conditions.
confusable: Not merely a strict host: B2 exposes why A copied removing dry shoes unnecessarily; A3 never admits the mistake.
comparison: Domestic hospitality supplies practical accommodation; the alternative controls a public swimming entrance.
seedUse: Retains welcoming guest with travel pressure from Drive seed; changes food restrictions to copied footwear.
